rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Rubric Protocol creates cryptographically signed attestation records of AI decisions using post-quantum cryptography, Merkle-chained records, and Hedera mainnet blockchain anchoring. Eight MCP tools cover decision attestation, verification, proof generation, and agent registration, with automatic mapping to regulatory frameworks including EU AI Act, HIPAA, and NIST AI RMF. Available as a free local tier (no API key) or paid tier with full audit features. Published to npm as @rubric-protocol/mcp-server.
